description: Firecrawl failure / changed markdown is silently swallowed and reported as success. run.sh:23 ends the scrape with '|| true' and '2>/dev/null'; the python parser at run.sh:24 runs with '2>/dev/null' and falls back to md="" when the file is missing (run.sh:27). If code4rena changes its markup (so the regex matches nothing) or firecrawl errors/returns empty, the result is 0 contests with NO error signal — the script still exits 0 and emit() narrates a normal-looking line. Worse, because json.dump always overwrites contests.json (run.sh:32), a transient empty scrape WIPES the previously-good contest list. There is no minimum-count guard, no 'contests dropped to 0 vs last run' alarm, and no test exercising the empty/changed-markdown path.

evidence.snippet:
"$FC" scrape "https://code4rena.com/audits" markdown > "$md" 2>/dev/null || true
... 
md=open(mdf,encoding="utf-8").read() if os.path.exists(mdf) else ""
...
json.dump({"fetched_at":...,"contests":ranked}, open(cj,"w"), indent=2)
